name: Evergreen
ability: Your alive neighbors can't turn evil.
flavor: Some things stay green no matter how cold it gets.

name: Sled
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: you gain their ability.
flavor: Downhill is the only direction it knows.
otherNightReminder: The Sled may choose a dead player: the Sled gains that ability.

name: Whistle
ability: If a player turns evil, that night you learn how many steps they are from the Demon.
flavor: One sharp blast and the whole yard freezes.
otherNightReminder: If a player turned evil since dawn, give a finger signal: their distance in steps from the Demon.

name: Boot
ability: Once per game, at night*, you may choose to die instead of the player the Demon attacks tonight. You learn their alignment, but not who they are.
flavor: Boots go where nobody else wants to step.
otherNightReminder: The Boot may choose to step in: mark them STEPPED IN. If the Demon attacks tonight, the Boot dies instead; show the Boot the target's alignment.

name: Chisel
ability: The first Outsider you vote on swaps characters with you.
flavor: Chip away long enough and anything becomes something else.

name: Tailor
ability: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. [+1 Outsider]
flavor: Measure twice, cut once, and always count the odd socks.

name: Mittens
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: if either is the Demon, the Demon must choose you tonight.
flavor: They always come in pairs. You always lose one.
otherNightReminder: The Mittens chooses 2 players. If either is the Demon, mark the Mittens CAUGHT: the Demon must include them tonight.

name: Campfire
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they are safe from the Demon tonight. If you are executed, an alive good neighbor becomes a Campfire.
flavor: Gather close; the dark can't reach the circle of light.
otherNightReminder: The Campfire chooses a player: mark them WARM.

name: Milk
ability: Each night, choose a player you haven't chosen before: you learn if they are a Cookies. Once you have chosen every Cookies, you turn evil.
flavor: The Cookies' best friend — right up until it isn't.
firstNightReminder: The Milk chooses a new player: mark them CHOSEN. Nod if they are a Cookies.
otherNightReminder: The Milk chooses a new player: mark them CHOSEN. Nod if they are a Cookies. If every Cookies is now CHOSEN, the Milk turns evil.

name: Cookies
ability: If all living good players are Cookies, good wins. [+0 to +2 Cookies]
flavor: Left out for Santa, eaten by everyone else.

name: Bell
ability: Each night*, you learn how many evil players are alive. If the number of living good and evil players is equal, you die.
flavor: It rings out the count, and one day it tolls for itself.

name: Lantern
ability: You start knowing 3 evil characters, 2 of which are in play.
flavor: Enough light to see the shapes, never enough to see the faces.
firstNightReminder: Show 3 evil character tokens, 2 of which are in play.

name: Shepherd
ability: If the Demon kills you, a living Minion becomes a Shepherd and turns good.
flavor: Even the black sheep can be brought home.
otherNightReminder: If the Demon killed the Shepherd, change a living Minion's token to Shepherd. They turn good; wake them to show it.

name: Fruitcake
ability: If you die at night, either all Cookies lose their ability or the Milk turns evil (Storyteller's choice).
flavor: Nobody asked for it. Nobody can get rid of it.

name: Button
ability: Each night*, you must choose a player you haven't chosen before: if they are an Outsider or Minion, an extra player dies tonight (the Demon's choice).
flavor: Hanging on by a thread.
otherNightReminder: The Button chooses a new player: mark them CHOSEN. If an Outsider or Minion, mark POPPED: the Demon kills an extra player tonight.

name: Candy
ability: The first time you vote, the Demon learns who you are. On night 1, choose a player: each night you register as waking if they slept, and as sleeping if they woke.
flavor: Sweet on the outside, a choking hazard on the inside.
firstNightReminder: The Candy chooses a player: mark them SWEET.
otherNightReminder: If the Candy voted for the first time today, wake the Demon and point to the Candy.

name: Sock
ability: If you are "mad" that you are a Sock, a good player (Demon's choice) turns evil and becomes a Coal.
flavor: Hung with care. Filled with disappointment.
otherNightReminder: If the Sock was mad about being the Sock today, the Demon chooses a good player: they become an evil Coal. Wake them to show it.

name: Coal
ability: You cannot die by execution. If you are executed, that night all Coal wake and choose a player: they die.
flavor: Naughty list, page one.
otherNightReminder: If a Coal was executed today, wake every Coal together: they choose a player, who dies.

name: Deer
ability: On your 1st night, choose a player: they become a not-in-play Outsider. [-1 Outsider]
flavor: Up on the housetop, with a hoof in everyone's business.
firstNightReminder: The Deer chooses a player: give them a not-in-play Outsider token and wake them to show it.

name: Elf
ability: Each night, choose a player: if you nominate them tomorrow and they are executed, they turn evil.
flavor: Makes the toys, checks the list, makes a few adjustments.
firstNightReminder: The Elf chooses a player: mark them TAGGED.
otherNightReminder: The Elf chooses a player: mark them TAGGED.

name: Top
ability: Each night, choose a player: until dusk, they register as waking if they slept, and as sleeping if they woke.
flavor: Spin it fast enough and nobody can tell which way it's facing.
firstNightReminder: The Top chooses a player: mark them SPUN.
otherNightReminder: The Top chooses a player: mark them SPUN.

name: Saint Nicholas
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: if exactly one of them woke tonight to use an ability, both die. Otherwise, one of them might die.
flavor: He's checked the list twice, and he's watching who stirs after dark.
otherNightReminder: The Saint Nicholas chooses 2 players. If exactly one woke tonight (count SPUN and SWEET as flipped), both die. Otherwise, one might die.
